name: Civilizations Wars: Ice Legend
author: Addicting Games
description: Build up your civilization and upgrade your skills as you try to conquer the world! Send your elves to the claim buildings that are scattered on the battlefield. Claimed buildings will produce units; the larger the building, the faster it will produce units. There are also crystals on the battlefield, which will produce crystal energy when captured. Crystal energy allows you to cast various spells on your enemies. Completing battles will grant you experience points and skill points. As you level up, new battle modes will become available.
